title: MIPR: A Benchmark for Reasoning-Intensive Multimodal Intent-to-Product Retrieval with Multi-Category Solutions
title_zh: MIPR：面向高推理需求与多类别解决方案的多模态意图到商品检索基准
abstract_en: Real-world e-commerce queries often express user intent without naming a target product, and a single intent may be fulfilled by products from multiple categories. However, existing multimodal retrieval benchmarks typically assume a relatively well-defined target, leaving retrieval for intents with multi-category solutions less explored. To fill this gap, we introduce MIPR, a benchmark for Multimodal Intent-to-Product Retrieval comprising 3,522 multimodal queries and a shared corpus of 30,731 products. MIPR features reasoning-intensive retrieval, multi-category solutions, and fine-grained relevance labels. Experiments show that the best embedding-based retriever achieves 49.23% nDCG@10 on the full query set, and 55.86% solution-category recall@10 on queries with multiple solution categories. Reranking improves these scores to 60.11% and 67.00%, respectively, yet substantial gaps to the candidate-pool oracle remain. These results establish MIPR as a challenging and diagnostic benchmark for evaluating multimodal intent-to-product retrieval. The data and code are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/leequeue/MIPR.
abstract_zh: 真实电商查询往往只描述用户想解决的问题，不直接指明目标商品，且同一意图可能由多个类别的商品满足。现有多模态检索基准通常假定目标相对明确，较少考察这类跨类别检索。为此，论文提出 MIPR（Multimodal Intent-to-Product Retrieval），包含 3,522 条多模态查询和一个由 30,731 件商品组成的共享语料库，重点考察需要推理的检索任务，并提供多类别解决方案和细粒度相关性标注。实验中，表现最好的嵌入式检索器在全量查询上的 nDCG@10 为 49.23%，在具有多个解决方案类别的查询上的解决方案类别召回率@10 为 55.86%。重排序将两项指标分别提升至 60.11% 和 67.00%，但与候选池内的理想排序（oracle）仍有明显差距。数据与代码已公开：https://huggingface.co/datasets/leequeue/MIPR。
key_points_zh: 检索目标不是用户点名的商品，而是能解决其问题的商品；同一意图可对应多个商品类别。
基准包含 3,522 条多模态查询、30,731 件共享候选商品，并提供细粒度相关性标注。
重排序将全量查询的 nDCG@10 从 49.23% 提升至 60.11%，将多类别查询的解决方案类别召回率@10 从 55.86% 提升至 67.00%。
重排序后仍明显落后于候选池内的理想排序，说明现有模型尚未充分利用已召回的候选商品。

llm_assessment.comment: This public benchmark makes cross-category shopping intent measurable and shows that reranking still leaves substantial room for improvement.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这一公开基准使跨品类购物意图下的检索质量可量化，并表明重排序后仍有较大改进空间。
